title: Why $22,500 Is the Max You Can Stash in a 401(k) This Year

scenes.text: Did you know $22,500 is the exact 401(k) cap for 2024?
The IRS raised the employee contribution limit to $22,500 for 2024.
If you’re 50 or older, you can add an extra $7,500 as a catch‑up contribution.
Max out your 401(k) to harness compounding power.
